libOverrides.dts.mjs: repo-root types/ dir holds ambient declaration augmentation (next-auth.d.ts, orbitdb.d.ts, window.d.ts), not a components export surface — upstream findTypesRoot's 'types' candidate matched it by name coincidence
libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: (1) static './dts.mjs' import bypasses package-build.mjs's override-aware loader — picks up the dts.mjs fork via sibling relative resolution. (2) synth content-scan was gated on components.length===0, which cfg.componentSrcMap's add side effect defeated when pinning TruthVerification — now always runs in synth-entry mode, unioned with componentSrcMap. (3) synth entry now exports the process-polyfill shim first (see .design-sync/shims/process-polyfill.mjs) — components/TruthVerification.tsx reads process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TRUTH_VERIFICATION_ADDRESS at module top level, which bundle.mjs's NODE_ENV-only esbuild define doesn't cover, crashing the whole IIFE before window.ActaMundi populates. (4) synth entry now excludes the unused components/truth-verification/TruthVerification.tsx duplicate by file path (ambiguous `export *` name collision was silently dropping window.ActaMundi.TruthVerification per ES module spec) and emits `export {default as Name}` instead of blind `export *` for default-exported files (ArticleSearch, RichTextEditor), since `export *` never forwards a default export. common.mjs/bundle.mjs imports repointed at staged lib, unmodified otherwise
